description.value:
A pawn with this Schematic installed can store up to 2 light Bulk of items in an empty compartment inside its body, though none of these items can be longer than 1 foot in any dimension. Anyone can place an item in the compartment or retrieve one from it with a single Interact action.

Incredible Space (maestro feat 14): the compartment gains the properties of a spacious pouch (up to 5 Bulk); not yet automated.
